notes.title: Update: Minor Improvements to Stroke Making
notes.notes: We’ve fine-tuned stroke mechanics for even smoother, more responsive shot-making. Every rally now feels snappier and more satisfying—perfect your timing and keep the rallies going!

notes.title: 🎾 Update Alert: Toonie Tennis Just Got Faster, Funnier, and Way More Intense!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to serve up a speedy new update! 💨

🚀 What’s New?

Faster Animations: Moves now feel snappier, tighter, and more satisfying. Your character reacts like they’ve had three espressos.

Longer Rallies: We’ve tweaked gameplay to reward timing and skill, so you can enjoy those epic back-and-forth moments that feel just right.

More Responsive Feel: Movement, shots, and reactions are now ultra-smooth—less delay, more oomph. You’ll feel the difference the moment you step on the court.

Basically? Toonie Tennis is now more toonie than ever.

⚡ Whether you're in it for the glory, the giggles, or just to melt your controller with ridiculous rallies, this update brings the heat.

Thanks for playing and smashing—it means a ton!
Let us know what you think, and keep those serves spicy! 🔥🎾
— rGyani Games

notes.title: 🎾 Toonie Tennis Update: New Courts, Smarter Slices, and Smoother Gameplay!
notes.notes:
Hey Toonie players!
We’ve just served up a fresh update packed with new content and gameplay improvements — check it out! 👇

🎾 New Playing Styles – Slice Like a Pro!
We’ve revamped shot mechanics so slices are now more effective and strategic. Whether you're faking out your opponent or setting up a killer rally, the court’s now your playground.

⚙️ Performance Boosts Across the Board
We’ve squashed bugs, optimized physics, and reduced input delay for an even smoother experience on all systems. Enjoy faster load times and more responsive controls!

Thanks for all your support and feedback — keep rallying and let us know what you’d love to see next.
🏁 Now get back out there and show us your best trick shot!

— The Toonie Tennis Dev Team 🧢

notes.title: 🎾 Toonie Tennis – Gameplay Improvements Update!
notes.notes:
Hey, Toonie Tennis fans!

We've been fine-tuning the game to bring you a smoother and more enjoyable experience. This update is all about refining gameplay and making sure every rally feels just right.

🔧 What's Improved?
✅ Smoother Controls – More responsive movements for better shot accuracy.
✅ Enhanced Ball Physics – Improved realism in bounces and spin.
✅ Better AI Balance – More competitive and fair AI opponents.
✅ UI & Visual Tweaks – Cleaner visuals for an even better experience.
✅ Minor Bug Fixes – Squashed a few pesky issues to keep gameplay seamless.

Thanks for playing Toonie Tennis! Keep the rallies going, and let us know your feedback.

🏆 See you on the court! 🏆
